slots.name: NICU count
slots.sentence: Now the country has 77 NICUs where 240 specialists are tasked with caring for some of the most vulnerable patients, according to the government and doctors groups.

slots.name: babies per specialist
slots.sentence: Some hospitals outside the capital only have one specialist to care for over 30 babies at once, doctors say.

slots.name: resident decrease
slots.sentence: The number of residents working in NICUs has decreased by 94 percent in recent years, according to government data .

slots.name: day care closures
slots.sentence: Over 40 percent of day care centers have shuttered in recent years.
